# Kasilapa Bay

> Beachfront homestay & accommodation in Tomia Island, Wakatobi, Indonesia.

Kasilapa Bay offers peaceful beachfront lodging in Kasilapa Village, Tomia Island, Wakatobi.

## Information & Services

- [Home](https://kasilapabay.vercel.app/id): Main homepage with resort overview and featured rooms.
- [Accommodation](https://kasilapabay.vercel.app/id/akomodasi): Room types (Deluxe Junior Suite, Deluxe Room, Deluxe Double) and facilities.
- [Destinations](https://kasilapabay.vercel.app/id/destinasi): Nearby tourist destinations in Tomia Island (Hondue Beach, Kahianga Peak, Roma Diving, Nata Fortress, Huntete Beach, Patua Fortress).
- [Gallery](https://kasilapabay.vercel.app/id/galeri): Photos of homestay property, underwater diving, and island scenery.
- [Reviews](https://kasilapabay.vercel.app/id/ulasan): Guest reviews and testimonials.
- [Contact](https://kasilapabay.vercel.app/id/kontak): Contact details, WhatsApp booking, and location map.
